mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sq_interaction (interaction_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, operation_id, origin, framework_request_id, kind, question, answer_schema_json, plan_version, request_hash, connection_revision, expires_at, status, version, scope_id, creator_id, creator_name, last_updater_id, last_updater_name) VALUES (#{interactionId}, #{userId}, #{taskId}, #{jobId}, #{bindingId}, #{operationId}, #{origin}, #{frameworkRequestId}, #{kind}, #{question}, #{answerSchemaJson}, #{planVersion}, #{requestHash}, #{connectionRevision}, #{expiresAt}, 'OPEN', 0, (SELECT scope_id FROM sq_runtime_binding WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId}), #{creatorId}, #{creatorName}, #{creatorId}, #{creatorName})
mapper.select: SELECT interaction_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, operation_id, origin, framework_request_id, kind, question, answer_schema_json, plan_version, request_hash, connection_revision, expires_at, status, version, scope_id, response_json FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND framework_request_id = #{frameworkRequestId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT interaction_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, operation_id, origin, framework_request_id, kind, question, answer_schema_json, plan_version, request_hash, connection_revision, expires_at, status, version, scope_id, response_json FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND interaction_id = #{interactionId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT interaction_id, user_id, task_id, job_id, binding_id, operation_id, origin, framework_request_id, kind, question, answer_schema_json, plan_version, request_hash, connection_revision, expires_at, status, version, scope_id, response_json FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND del_flag = '0' AND id < #{cursorId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT interaction_id FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND task_id = #{taskId} AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY id ASC LIMIT 8
SELECT id FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND interaction_id = #{interactionId} AND del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: UPDATE sq_interaction SET status = 'RESPONDED', response_json = COALESCE(response_json, #{responseJson}), version = version + 1, last_updater_id = 'framework' WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND binding_id = #{bindingId} AND framework_request_id = #{frameworkRequestId} AND status = 'OPEN'
mapper.select: SELECT interaction_id FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND status = 'OPEN' AND del_flag = '0' ORDER BY id
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sq_interaction WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND scope_id = #{scopeId} AND kind = #{kind} AND status = 'OPEN' AND del_flag = '0'
